scope: Catalog identity pre-state/candidate/post-state matching and finalization only; containing acceptance/value/transform/report/executor profiles also apply

units.retainedCatalogEntries: Total retained type/property/relationship/key definitions across active/provisional/retired states; repeated owner references do not create definitions
units.candidateCatalogEntries: Complete candidate definitions across the same four namespaces
units.newCatalogEntries: Genuinely new definitions after complete original matching; no duplicate/retired-match evasion
units.individualLineagePreimageBytes: Complete canonical transport preimage, including framing
units.retainedIdentityCarrierBytes: Sum of full retained identity preimages, not digest lengths
units.candidateIdentityCarrierBytes: Sum of full candidate identity preimages, not digest lengths
units.metadataResultBytes: Complete encoded metadata over all identity stages; decoder/native adapter expansion also charges ownedBytes
units.nativeIdentityRowsObserved: Every actually returned pre/post/refetch identity row; repeated real work charges again
units.comparisonWorkUnits: One byte examined/copied during full identity comparison or canonical matching; ledger charges actual repeated work
units.ownedBytes: All original identity input/candidate/native adapter/decoder/sort/group/evidence buffers and still-owned uncertainty reservations
units.elapsedMilliseconds: One original monotonic identity-operation deadline, including native waits/transport; containing acceptance deadline may be stricter
units.containmentMilliseconds: Original containment observation budget; expiry retains original recovery, not confirmed termination

qualification: Proposed defaults only. Native detoast/sort/workspace, producer allocator and adapter enforcement must be selected and independently qualified. No result-size-only guarantee.
